description:
The Original Folding Fat Tire Electric Bike
The Sierra Electric Folding Fat Tire Bike brings rough and tough, off-road, and folding capabilities to the hot line-up from E-Lux Electric Bikes! Great for the RV, camping, trail riding, as well as the beach or boardwalk. These bikes go everywhere and can be stored almost anywhere! Easily fitting in the back of your car or truck, it takes seconds to launch for hours of fun.
Featuring - High Density Panasonic 48 volt 11ah battery, Bafang 500-watt (750 peak) motor, Shimano Altus 7 speed derailleur, Bigstone LCD display with USB port, Pedal Assist power delivery with “Always On” throttle override, adjustable power modes to control the force of acceleration (high power for hill climbing or lower power Eco mode to extend range,) Tektro Aries M-300 brakes with Oversized 203 mm disc brakes, and folding pedals! There is even a convenient frame integrated water bottle space behind the seat post!

Display: Backlit LCD Display w/ USB Charger, MPH, Voltage, Battery Range, Ride Time & Odometer

If your color is not available please call to check backorder availability.
